name: shop-api
prompt: Read the port from the environment and switch to the structured logger

files.README.md:
# Shop API

Run `pnpm dev` and open http://localhost:3000.

bash: sed -i '' -e 's/port = 3000/port = Number(process.env.PORT ?? 3000)/' -e 's/console.log("listening on", port);/logger.info({ port }, "listening");/' src/app.ts

python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
app = Path('src/app.ts')
app.write_text('import { logger } from "./log";\n' + app.read_text())
readme = Path('README.md')
readme.write_text(readme.read_text().replace('http://localhost:3000', 'http://localhost:$PORT (default 3000)'))
Path('docs').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
Path('docs/configuration.md').write_text('# Configuration\n\n| Variable | Default |\n| --- | --- |\n| `PORT` | `3000` |\n')
PY

steps.text: Done. The server reads `PORT` and logs through the structured logger.
